definition: Major changes in form, appearance, character, or circumstances.
book: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: My visitor, who had watched these metamorphoses with a keen eye, smiled, set down the glass upon the table, and then turned and looked upon me with an air of scrutiny.
example_sentence: The garden went through three metamorphoses before we finally liked it.
